title: Animal Evolution Sim Ancestors Gets Surprise PS5 Version, Free Upgrade for PS4 Owners
summary:
Out on 8th December 2026.

Did you ever think you'd hear of the forgotten PS4 animal evolution sim Ancestors: A Humankind Odyssey again? I most certainly didn't, but here we are with the announcement of a PS5 version coming 8th December 2026.

Panache Digital Games revealed it'll be debuting on Nintendo consoles with a Switch 2 edition, which I suspect is the main reason behind today's reveal. However, in the process, the developer has also decided to put out native PS5 and Xbox Series X|S versions.

title: The Third Version of Arizona Sunshine Is Dated for January 2027
summary:
Third time's a charm?

The third version of Arizona Sunshine, which will be completely stripped of any VR support, will be one of the PS5 titles that kicks off 2027, now dated for 21st January 2027.

Originally a PSVR effort on PS4, which was then remade for PS5's dead headset PSVR2, Vertigo Games is trying once more with a third version that plays like a standard PS5 experience with a third-person camera. It's available to pre-order now for £19.99 / $24.99, but PS Plus members can get a 20% discount up until the game releases.

title: PS1 Classics on PS5 Keep on Coming in Dino Crisis 2, Out Next Week
summary:
But don't expect Trophies.

Capcom classic Dino Crisis 2 will be made available on PS5 and PS4 via the PS Store from next Tuesday, 20th October 2026. The game will be part of PS Plus Premium straight away, but it'll also be purchasable outside of the subscription, most likely for £7.99 / $9.99.

This will be a port of the PS1 version, but it'll ship with the bells and whistles of Sony's classic conversion process, such as rewind features, video filters, and quick save options. However, you shouldn't expect Trophy support: Capcom's own classic titles that have been ported to PS5 and PS4 unfortunately haven't come with any Trophy lists.

In the aftermath of its decision to stop manufacturing physical games in 2028, fans mobilised to create a boycott at the end of August, which encouraged players to disconnect their consoles and stay offline.
